title: Add durable automations managed work and bounded recovery
what: Support event and scheduled automations, isolated child sessions, coordinator results, incident and scan workflows, and explicit cost/retry limits. Reuse existing GitHub lifecycle and deployment tickets instead of duplicating them.

acceptance.text: Schedules handle time zones, duplicate delivery, pause and cancellation
An event starts at most one logical automation run across retries
Child sessions have isolated workspaces and scoped credentials
The coordinator observes child completion or requests for help and resumes after restart
Budgets and repeated failures stop escalation and notify participants
Merge and deployment actions use explicit authorization and recovery rather than implicit permission
